# Muhammad Abubakar

Muhammad Abubakar provides automotive electrical, hybrid, electric vehicle, gearbox and car AC diagnostics and repair. He has 12+ years of hands-on experience and offers remote diagnostic assistance. Service availability and repair options depend on the vehicle and inspection findings.

For a vehicle-specific question, include the make, model, year, exact warning or symptom, and any available fault-code report. Do not infer a confirmed fault or quote from the guides alone.
